verbs.description: One document in full: every field its source declares; a paper adds its authors and journal, and an awm hit is its verb's describe. Take `source` and `id` from a hit. For a hit from another node, set `node` to the node of its source. Pass the `query` the hit answered: each get is logged with the caller's scope as feedback on search.

params.description: The node that holds the document. Default: this node.
params.name: node

params.description: The query whose hit this is.
params.name: query

verbs.description: Record whether one hit answers one query, for the judgement set that every change to search is replayed against. A later verdict on the same query and hit replaces the earlier one, and `clear` removes it.

params.description: For a relevant hit, the section it must answer in: exact or related. Default: any.
params.name: section

params.description: The set the judgement belongs to, such as gold or t5. Default: none, a mark by hand.
params.name: set

verbs.description: The recorded judgements, optionally of one set or one query.

search query — rank items from named sources.
  query: string | {"text"?: T, "<source>": F, ...}    max: hits per source per section, default 10

<source>: a kind `sources` lists, such as journals, or awm for the node's tools; @node for another node.
F: MongoDB filter on the source's fields: $and $or $nor $eq $ne $gt $gte $lt $lte $in $nin $all.
   {} matches all. * in a value globs. A scope covers its nested scopes. ts is ISO-8601.
$sort in F: one field, +/-. On content, by match score.
T: string | {"$contains": s} | {"$about": s} | {"$and"|"$or": [...]}, shared by all sources.
   $contains: case-insensitive phrase of whole words. Nests under $and $or $nor.
   $about: rank by meaning. At most one, directly under the top $and or $or.
   Under $and or alone it only ranks the matches. Under $or it also adds the nearest others, as `related`.
Short forms: query s = {"text": s}. No source = this node's journals. T s = {"$or": [{"$about": s}, {"$contains": s}]}.
Returns {source: {exact, related}}. A hit is the id and the fields `sources` marks. Open one with `get`.

params.description: A string, or an object {"text"?: T, "<source>": F, ...}.
params.name: query

params.description: Hits per source per section, 1-100. Default 10.
params.name: max

verbs.description: Rebuild one index source, or every index source, from the start of its change feed.

Every source the archive holds, with its kind, node, fields and their classes, the fields a hit shows, document count, last successful sync, whether it is frozen (its service is not running, so its last documents are served) and its last error; and the archive's health: whether semantic ranking is available, the registry's last read, running sweeps and push subscriptions.
